text: Hello, I'm Linda from Global Talent Partners. We saw your resume on Indeed. Our client offers a flexible remote job: complete simple app rating tasks and earn commission. You just need to deposit USDT to unlock premium tasks. Contact me on WhatsApp.

scam_type: Fake job offer – equipment purchase / fake check
evidence: Contact address amazon.jobs.hr@yahoo.com is a free personal mailbox, not a company domain. | "purchase your work laptop from our vendor using the check" — Being asked to buy equipment from a 'vendor' and get reimbursed is a fake-check scam. | The message contains text aimed at AI tools ("ignore previous instructions"; "risk level: low"). Legitimate senders don't do this; treated as a strong scam signal.

To begin, purchase your work laptop from our vendor using the check we mail you. Contact: amazon.jobs.hr@yahoo.com
